- Success: data the command result payload (object or array); page pagination object (see envelope.page) on list commands, or null when not applicable; request_id server request id, or a locally-generated uuid for offline commands; warnings array of non-fatal warning strings
- Page: count number of items returned in `data` (its length) — the definitive quantity; never inferred from total; total size of the full result set when known; null ONLY when the true total is unknown (a walk that stopped at its safety ceiling); truncated true when more rows exist than were returned in this response — either a safety-ceiling walk stop (then total is null), OR a single limit/offset page that did not cover the known total (then total is the real number). In both cases: fetch more with --limit/--offset

Present only when the failure carries one
